scope: Read-only source and primary web evidence; no synthesis, compilation, emulator/game execution, hardware test, or media modification.

recommendation.primary: Standalone Pocket openFPGA Archimedes core using Archie_MiSTer rtl/ as the working chipset baseline, with an APF Pocket shell and replacement host services.
recommendation.reason: Latest inspected MiSTer source includes self-contained FDC/IDE RTL and current chipset maintenance. MiST predecessor supplies a smaller-FPGA target and useful CPU fuzz tests; use it as an architecture/resource cross-reference, not automatically the current behavior baseline.
recommendation.first_proof_gate: Build a ROM-free Pocket synthesis/timing/resource smoke target for retained ARM26/MEMC/VIDC/IOC and a real external-memory adapter, after a module/license/dependency manifest. The gate is actual 5CEBA4 fit and timing closure with APF; do not infer either from MiST target or Pocket capacities.
recommendation.media_gate: A second, independent early gate must show how these local JFDs will boot: most conservative candidate is user-provisioned RISC OS 3.11 plus ADFFS on HDF. ADF conversion is conditional on preserving required JFD sectors/protection/deltas/boot behavior.
recommendation.fallback: ArcEm ARM26 C interpreter app on openfpgaOS is a benchmark-first alternative if OS hosting becomes a requirement; no evidence here establishes adequate Pocket CPU performance.

hardware_components.evidence: rtl/archimedes_top.v:140 instantiates a23_core; rtl/amber/a23_execute.v:333 restricts access to 26-bit space; a23_register_bank.v:65,272-284 combines 24-bit word PC [25:2] with flags/interrupt/mode bits in R15.
rtl/memc.v and memc_translator.v implement CPU/DMA/translation/protection; translator has 128-entry page table, 32 KiB output-page layout (128*32 KiB = 4 MiB mapped physical RAM).
rtl/vidc/vidc.v, vidc_timing.v, vidc_audio.v, DMA/FIFO modules; palette/pixel timing, DMA and sound exist.
hardware_components.license: BSD style headers in inspected VIDC main module; audit each retained file

hardware_components.evidence: rtl/ioc.v, ioc_irq.v implement IO/timers/interrupts; external keyboard interface supplied by wrapper host.
hardware_components.license: BSD style per-file header in ioc.v

hardware_components.evidence: rtl/fdc/fdc1772.sv:104-115 IMG_ARCHIE uses regular 1024-byte sectors, sector IDs starting at 0, fixed 5/10 sectors per track and LBA reads.
rtl/archimedes_top.v:381 instantiates podule_ide; podule_ide.sv:43-44 embeds 16 KiB riscdevide ROM via readmemh. ide.v provides host management port.
hardware_components.license: podule_ide.sv GPL-3.0-or-later; ide.v BSD style; embedded ROM licensing not verified

licensing.readme_summary: MiSTer ReadMe.md says core dual LGPL/BSD and Amber LGPL.
licensing.source_discrepancy: Do not use README summary as blanket grant: rtl/archimedes_top.v and fdc1772.sv and podule_ide.sv carry GPL-3.0-or-later; Archie.sv wrapper is GPL-2.0-or-later; Amber LGPL-2.1-or-later; major peripherals BSD style.
licensing.adffs: Public author release lists source288.zip; no license text found on release page. Source archive was not obtained because attachment access failed/Cloudflare blocked direct HTTP; reuse/redistribution terms remain unverified.
licensing.game: JASPP Lotus page says distribution rights held by JASPP. That does not establish permission for this project to repackage game files.
licensing.rom: User must separately provision suitable RISC OS ROM and any needed boot/components. No ROM binaries were downloaded or checked out.

pocket_fit.plausibility: Original MiST target is EP3C25 Cyclone III, so small-FPGA implementation has a source history. Pocket RAM capacity exceeds 4 MiB guest RAM plus typical 2 MiB RISC OS 3 image.
pocket_fit.limits: Neither device name nor memory capacity proves fit, bandwidth, power, or correct memory latency. No Quartus utilization/Fmax/timing report was found in checked-out source. Pocket/APF pin, clock, memory and video adapters remain work.
pocket_fit.mister_clocks: Archie.sv:281 CLKSYS=42 MHz; rtl/sdram.v:108 RAM_CLK=126 MHz. MiST top comments use 40 MHz system/120 MHz memory. Preserve guest timing intent; retarget PLL/IP and memory adapter rather than copy board clock assumptions.

media.native_floppy_support: MiSTer README supports two drives with ADF exactly 819200 bytes, not JFD; RTL IMG_ARCHIE regular sector backend confirms no native JFD parser.
media.jfd_path: ADFFS mounted from a guest hard drive can supply JFD at the guest filing-system/controller abstraction level. Must prove actual local images, game script and any required compatibility deltas on this core.
media.adffs_version: 2.88 posted 2026-03-28; author lists A-series 4 MiB RAM minimum, RISC OS 3.10+, hard-drive install. Lists Arculator recommended configuration and all other emulators untested.
media.lotus_requirements: JASPP entry ID 10232 lists ARM2 through newer CPUs, original game 1024 KiB RAM, OS 3.11+; use Boot floppy. These are published compatibility claims, not this project's validation.
media.timing_risk: Author's Lotus thread follow-up describes VSync-count/T1-tick-based raster palette timing and possible lock on unexpected VSync; Pocket presentation adaptation must not silently change guest timing.
media.jfd_conversion_rule: Do not simply unzip JFD to ADF or rename extension. Conversion can discard physical-sector layout, CRC/protection flags, delta sectors and script behavior; acceptance requires explicit comparison and runtime proof.
media.rom_size_evidence: Arculator romload.c:227-233 caps contiguous ROM load at 0x200000; older author Arculator readme gives SAVE rom 3800000+200000 for RISC OS 3. Use actual user image size/hash as definitive input.
media.rom_provisioning_status: Official Classic ROMs product page documents contiguous 3.11 ROM and boot/apps/utilities. Emulation index currently shows Ordering Offline. No purchase/download was attempted.

host_adaptation: Replace MiSTer HPS_BUS/hps_io EXT_BUS with APF bridge/data slots and Pocket options.
Implement ROM transfer/reset gating; RISC OS boot and CMOS/RTC initialization/save.
Implement filesystem/block service for floppy sectors and HDF/IDE management; choose read-only originals and explicit separate writable user storage.
Translate Pocket/Dock gamepad events to Archimedes keyboard/joystick protocol; support boot/menu/function keys and multi-disk selection.
Replace sys/ MiSTer video/audio plumbing with Pocket APF output, retaining guest VIDC timing and palette behavior.
Retarget board-specific PLL and SDRAM/PSRAM IP with arbitration for CPU/VIDC/sound/host transfer.
Audit embedded RiscDev IDE ROM dependency before build/publication; original source-only snapshot deliberately excludes it.

arcem_fallback.cpu: armemu.c:1155+ ARMul_Emulate26 runs a C instruction interpreter with optional cached instruction-handler pointers; no ARM-to-RISC-V native code generator was found in inspected core.
arcem_fallback.host_portability: armemu.h:27-57 detects ARM/x86/PPC optimizations and has generic immediate-table fallback for unknown host; RISC-V compilation is not tested.
arcem_fallback.platform_changes: CMakeLists.txt exposes X, SDL1/2/3, macOS, Windows backends. SDK video/audio/input, timers, file I/O, callbacks/control UI and optionally HostFS need a new platform backend.
arcem_fallback.memory: arch/armarc.c:294-329 allocates guest RAM+ROM and optional equally proportional instruction handler cache on a 32-bit host; measured heap and SDRAM placement required.
arcem_fallback.disk: arch/fdc1772.c:127-136 only lists flat ADFS/DOS geometries. No direct JFD path found. Guest ADFFS likely needs HostFS or implemented HDF controller; ArcEm current disk controller is HDC63463/ST506.
arcem_fallback.limits: A software port cannot be promised full speed from 100 MHz host CPU rating; instruction/memory/MMIO/audio/render costs need measurement. ADFFS/MMU/protection compatibility needs independent proof.

existing_pocket_core_search.result: No Archie or Archimedes entry found in current library page and no specific Pocket repo found in focused searches.
existing_pocket_core_search.limits: Catalog/search absence is discovery evidence only; not proof no unpublished or unindexed port exists.

proof_milestones.name: Source dependency and license manifest
proof_milestones.pass: List retained HDL/APF/memory IP and ROM-dependent modules at pinned revisions; resolve embedded ROM/ADFFS redistribution terms before distributing them.

proof_milestones.name: Pocket resource and memory gate
proof_milestones.pass: Actual 5CEBA4 target synthesis+fit+timing report, constrained clocks, external-memory stress and DMA arbitration; no guest media required for initial gate.

proof_milestones.name: Boot gate
proof_milestones.pass: User-provisioned RISC OS 3.11 boots with 4 MiB guest memory, stable video, IOC IRQ/timers, keyboard, sound and CMOS reset/persistence.

proof_milestones.name: JFD boot gate
proof_milestones.pass: Guest HDF/block route reads these immutable local JFDs through a pinned ADFFS package and Boot floppy; prove both disk switching and script/delta application. Flat ADF shortcut only after a documented validity test.

proof_milestones.name: Lotus runtime gate
proof_milestones.pass: Hardware title/demo/race, music/effects, palette raster, steering/throttle/brake/menu, later stages and disk transitions; record observed stability and timing separately from build success.
